newsitem.title: ITALY: IMI, Olivetti exposure not a risk - Salomon.
newsitem.headline: IMI, Olivetti exposure not a risk - Salomon.

text.p: Italian investment bank IMI has an exposure of over 700 billion lire to the troubled information technology group Olivetti, but it is an exposure without risk, said broker Salomon Brothers in a research note.
The note said that IMI does carry a large long-term financial exposure to Olivetti for, as the broker understands, research and development and not for general operating purposes.
"This exposure tops 700 billion lire, but it is entirely guaranteed by other banks or collateralised with government securities on deposit. It is therefore an exposure without risk," the note said.

IMI has beyond that a minuscule residual exposure elsewhere in the Olivetti group, and for Saloman's purposes this exposure is negligible, added the note which was reiterating the broker's buy recommendation for IMI.
Olivetti had group net debts of 2.394 trillion lire at August 31, and the company expects this to fall to around 2 trillion lire by the end of this year.
